limitations_and_recovered_attempts.observation: Context-tool subprocess lacked native runtime and user-bus variables. Initial browser dashboard appeared empty and service query failed. Owned subprocess browser was closed; native desktop runtime showed the owned active session and successful service metadata.
The initial archive /api/sessions and Dagu /api/v2/dag-runs guesses returned HTML. They were rejected as data evidence. Actual browser-discovered v1 APIs were used.
Some early DOM reads preceded data loading, and readiness checks used labels unavailable during transitions. Settled observations and matching returned APIs are recorded; failed attempts retained.
17 stored rows are preserved. Default list returns4; including single-turn sessions returns14 top-level rows, with3 subagent rows separate. All three requested selected snapshots were observed.
Today shows no runs. Last30days shows9 stored runs, including6success,2failed,1cancelled.
/dashboard/usage redirects to logs. /dashboard/analytics displays the matching30-day native summary.
The instant Claude query has0series; the preceding1-hour range has4historical series. Historical display is not current activity or current zero.
